intent: A searchable shortcut reference with engraved keycaps and grouped commands, built for help panels and desktop-style web applications.

layout.direction: A compact keyboard reference with a 30px Instrument Serif heading, a clear 44px search field, 12px group labels and a two-column definition list of command names and engraved monospaced keycaps. Keep neutral graphite surfaces and readable rules. The search boundary has at least 3:1 contrast against the panel, long commands and key labels wrap, and filtering does not collapse the minimum results region.
layout.container: Fill the parent up to 512px with 24px padding.

motion.entrance: Enter the card once with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Keep 150ms clear-button feedback and a stable minimum results region while filtering.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes and stop and settle the owned entrance immediately. Remove press transforms.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: items
props.description: Grouped command labels and display key sequences with stable unique IDs. Filtering matches the rendered label, group and key strings. Display only; global shortcuts are not registered.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Accessible search label and visible prompt. Clear returns focus to this field; Escape clears a non-empty query.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Preserve ShortcutEntry, ShortcutReferenceProps and the named ShortcutReference export. The reference displays host commands and key labels; it does not register or execute keyboard shortcuts.
Filter labels, groups and the rendered key strings, trimming the query and matching case-insensitively. Keep group order from the supplied items and show only matching entries.

Use a labelled controlled text input. The clear action appears for non-empty input, clears the filter and returns focus to the input before the action disappears. Escape clears a non-empty filter while focus stays in the input.
Keep definition-list semantics and instance-scoped heading IDs. Empty lists and unmatched queries have written feedback; later-arriving items respect the retained query.

Support long command names, group names, key labels, Unicode and independent instances without overflow or shared search state. Use at least 3:1 contrast for the search boundary and clear visible focus.
The host owns the command catalogue, platform-specific key labels and actual shortcut registration. Search uses displayed strings without inventing aliases or OS behavior.
